upgrades.title:
Harden the landed round-trip check in tests/test_roundtrip.py with three new fixtures — a CRLF file ('a

b
'), a UTF-8 multibyte file ('héllo wörld 🌍
'), and a 0-byte empty file — then fix the newline-translation fidelity drift they expose: get_file_contents in scripts/export_repo.py reads text with universal-newline mode (collapsing 
 to 
) and scripts/import_repo.py re-reads the bundle the same way, so CRLF files do not survive byte-identical; open all four text handles with newline='' (export read in get_file_contents, export bundle writer, import parse reader, import restore writer)

Add tests/test_cli.py — first subprocess coverage of the command-line entry points (only the library functions are tested today): run scripts/export_repo.py <temp source repo with a text and a binary file> with cwd set to a temp output dir and assert exit 0 plus a *_export_*.txt bundle containing 'REPOSITORY EXPORT:' was created; run scripts/import_repo.py <bundle> -o <temp restore dir> and assert exit 0 and the restored tree is byte-identical to the source; assert --help exits 0 for both scripts; assert importing a nonexistent bundle exits nonzero with 'Error:' in output; repair any CLI bug these runs expose
